messages:
Maya: quick multiworkload sweep results: A100 vs H100 across NA/EU/APAC with mixed qps (chat + embeddings). high-level: H100 beats A100 on p50/p95 decode for long-contexts, but A100 still cheaper $/1M in several steady-state configs. kernel fallthrough on H100 in APAC causing tail spikes, looks like `fast_attn_v2` not selected for some prefills. :thinking_face:
Jordan: can you paste the minimal table? also which models and quant levels?
Maya: models: mosaic-7b, llama-2-7b-chat, and mpt-7b; quant: q4_0 and int8x4 where supported. workloads: 40/40/20 chat/short/emb. brief table:
```
model | gpu | region | p50_prefill_ms | p95_decode_ms | toks/sec | $/1M_tokens
mosaic-7b | H100 | eu-west | 40 | 185 | 2300 | $13.9
mosaic-7b | A100 | eu-west | 52 | 225 | 1900 | $11.8
llama-2-7b-chat | H100 | na-east | 38 | 170 | 2450 | $15.2
llama-2-7b-chat | A100 | na-east | 48 | 210 | 2000 | $12.6
mpt-7b | H100 | apac-sg | 45 | 240 | 1800 | $16.8
mpt-7b | A100 | apac-sg | 60 | 280 | 1500 | $14.2
```
Maya: notes: - H100 gives ~15-25% decode speedup at p50, p95 uplift lower in APAC due to kernel selection fallback. - A100 price advantage driven by lower spot SKU costs in APAC and fewer kernel fallbacks for q4_0. - We saw `kernel_choice: fallback->generic_gemm` logged for H100 in some APAC jobs (likely driver/runtime mismatch).
Keiko: did you run with `--kp=auto` or forced `fast_attn_v2`?
Maya: used auto first, then verified by forcing `--kernel fast_attn_v2` for a subset. forcing recovered p95 in eu and na but did not in some sg hosts (same job, different nodes).
Rafael: any KV cache impact notes? our prefills had ~20% shorter prefill on H100 -> reduces overall token cost for chat with long prompts. that explains some of the $/1M moves.
Maya: yep. KV cache hit-rate was ~0.12 higher on H100 runs (we think due to lower scheduler preemption).
Jordan: deployment/ops question: how big a fleet diff to hit target qps? e.g., 1M tok/min target -> how many A100 vs H100?
Maya: roughback-of-envelope from toks/sec numbers: for mosaic-7b steady chat QPS mix -> H100: ~4300 tok/s per GPU (mixed batching) => ~140 GPUs for 1M tok/min. A100: ~3500 tok/s => ~170 GPUs. leads to ~20% fewer H100s at peak but cost delta depends on SKU price.
OpsBot: deploy note: Canary build 2026.03.18.9 started for `bench-sweep-3640004321`. Link: <https://go/redwood/bench/3640004321> :rocket:
Keiko: action items?
Maya: 1) file infra ticket to check H100 kernel selector + driver in APAC (small reproducible job attached). 2) expand forced `fast_attn_v2` check across more nodes. 3) updated pricing calc with current spot SKU rates and publish to docs. I'll open PR with full csv.
Jordan: thanks — can you drop the PR and a short executive bullet for product? one-liner on tradeoffs (latency vs $) would help.
Maya: posted PR #8977 and added short bullet in PR description. TL;DR: choose H100 for latency-critical long-context workloads; choose A100 for cost-sensitive steady-state q4_0 workloads, esp. in APAC where spot pricing helps.
Rafael: tagging perf-team for visibility. :eyes:
